facts.business: Centrum Capital Limited is a diversified financial services company operating through subsidiaries in investment banking, wealth management, alternatives (Modulus Alternatives), securities broking, and banking (Unity Bank), with a strategic focus on scaling responsibly and sustainably.
key_risks: Regulatory and compliance risks across diversified financial services
Execution risk in scaling diversified businesses
Credit and market risks in lending and broking subsidiaries
facts.related_party_note: The Company issued and allotted 7,01,26,225 Warrants on preferential basis to JBCG Advisory Services Private Limited, a Promoter Group entity, at an issue price of Rs 28.52 per Warrant, aggregating to approximately Rs 200 crore. 25% of the total consideration was received upon allotment. Pursuant to exercise of Warrants on March 27, 2026, the Company allotted 2,72,50,000 Equity Shares. The Company also issued and allotted 4,35,46,454 Equity Shares on preferential basis to certain marquee identified investors under the non-promoter category at an issue price of Rs 34.38 per Equity Share, raising Rs 149.71 crore. The Company provides Corporate Guarantees and funding support (Inter-corporate Deposits/subscription to securities) to subsidiaries Centrum Financial Services Limited (CFSL), Centrum Broking Limited (CBL), and Centrum Finverse Limited (CFL) for their business operations and credit facilities.
